title: Book One · Chapter 95: The Owner Tries It
story:
Ronan brings Dad a clean cloth at the counter.

Mum washed the lunch bag. She wants this cloth back before evening. Ronan is careful to explain both parts of the message.

Dad smiles. “Delivered clearly.”

The shop is quiet. There are still many jobs on the bench. Ronan sees the returned handle. It is on a shelf near the front. Its card is still tied to it.

“Has the man come?” he asks.

“Not yet.”

“Will you tell him you are sorry?”

“I said, ‘I am sorry.’ I will show him the new work when he comes.”

Ronan sits on the low chair. He has only a few minutes before Mum expects him. “When the big hand reaches six, you must go,” Dad says.

The owner arrives before it gets there. He carries an empty basket. He looks at his repaired handle on the shelf. He does not smile.

Dad brings it to the counter. Mr Sun stays beside him.

“I fastened the loose part again,” Dad says. “Then I checked the whole handle. We both tried it.”

The man pulls the handle. Then he turns it slowly. He tries it harder than Ronan expects. Dad does not stop him.

“It feels better,” the man says.

“There is no charge. This was my mistake,” Dad tells him.

“I brought it back. That took half my morning.”

“I understand.”

Ronan wishes the man would say it is all right now. The man does not. He checks underneath it and asks another question. At last he puts it in his basket.

Mr Sun gives him the old card. He adds a short new note about the work. The man reads it. Then he leaves.

No one claps. Dad wipes the counter.

“Was he still cross?” Ronan asks.

“A little.”

“But you fixed it.”

“Yes. That fixes the handle. It does not give him his morning back.”

Mr Sun takes the next card from the waiting line. They need to agree on a collection day. “How long will it take?” Mr Sun asks Dad. Dad looks carefully and turns the part over. He asks one question about a new part.

Ronan hears the clock strike. He stands up at once.

“I have to go. Mum is waiting.”

“Thank you. You remembered the time,” Dad says.

On the way home, Ronan finds Leo outside Mr Qiu's stall. Leo wants to show him a funny picture in a book. Ronan wants to see it.

“I said I would be home now,” he says. “Can you bring it tomorrow?”

Leo says yes. He does not sound pleased or angry. He is simply going somewhere else with his book.

Ronan gets home while Mum is still clearing the table. He gives her the cloth.

Later, Dad comes home hungry. “The owner collected the handle,” he tells Mum. She asks about the rest of the week. They speak about ordinary hours and ordinary pay. Ronan listens for a moment. Then he looks again at Leo's picture. Leo drew the funny picture on a scrap for him.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- new part＝新的零件
- collection＝取回
- no charge＝不收费
- fastened＝固定牢了

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：basket＝篮子；bench＝工作台；underneath＝底下。

## 读句提示

**How long will it take?**

这件工作／将花／多久？直接问句不藏在asks how long中。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么修好物品没有让顾客马上完全满意？
2. Ronan怎样把一次普通约定认真做完？
